Race Time Sorting

Problem Statement

Write a program to sort race completion times and determine the winner (the fastest time).

Input Format

Line 1: Number of participants (N)
Next N lines: Completion time of each participant in seconds

Output Format

Line 1: Sorted race times (space-separated)
Line 2: Fastest Time (Winner)
